scenes.title: Flight to Portugal or Farm in the Countryside
scenes.summary: As the presenter announces the first election numbers, two viewers panic and plan to flee abroad until a sudden lead change makes them fall in love with Brazil again.
scenes.location: living room sofa in front of the television

scenes.title: Deleting Posts and Praising the Heat
scenes.summary: Another swing in the vote count sends the pair scrambling to delete their social media accounts before votes from the Northeast have them celebrating the tropical sun.
scenes.location: living room sofa in front of the television

scenes.title: Church, Breakup, and True Love
scenes.summary: Rapid-fire lead changes push the two viewers from sudden religious devotion to breaking up on the spot and then declaring eternal love.
scenes.location: living room sofa in front of the television

scenes.title: Cheese Bread and Packing for Florida
scenes.summary: A surprise third candidate briefly turns them into fans of country cooking before the final lead change leaves them planning a move to Florida.
scenes.location: living room sofa in front of the television
